title: Hamlet
synopsis: The Prince of Denmark seeks revenge against his uncle Claudius, who murdered his father and married his mother. Haunted by his father's ghost and consumed by indecision, Hamlet's quest for vengeance leads to tragedy for nearly everyone at the Danish court.

title: A Streetcar Named Desire
synopsis: Blanche DuBois arrives at her sister Stella's cramped New Orleans apartment, fleeing a troubled past. Her presence creates tension with Stella's husband Stanley, whose brutal honesty exposes Blanche's fragile mental state and secrets, leading to her ultimate breakdown.

title: Death of a Salesman
synopsis: Aging salesman Willy Loman struggles with his fading career and strained relationships with his sons. As reality and memory blur, Willy confronts the failure of the American Dream and his own misguided values, culminating in a desperate final act.

title: The Crucible
synopsis: In 1692 Salem, Massachusetts, a group of girls are caught dancing in the woods and spark a witch hunt that consumes the town. John Proctor must choose between his reputation and his conscience as hysteria and false accusations destroy the community.

title: Romeo and Juliet
synopsis: Two young lovers from feuding families in Verona fall deeply in love and secretly marry. Their forbidden romance leads to a series of tragic misunderstandings and deaths, ultimately reconciling their warring families through shared grief.

title: Waiting for Godot
synopsis: Two tramps, Vladimir and Estragon, wait endlessly by a tree for someone named Godot who never arrives. Through circular conversations and encounters with strange characters, the play explores themes of existentialism, hope, and the human condition.

title: The Glass Menagerie
synopsis: Tom Wingfield reflects on his life with his overbearing mother Amanda and fragile sister Laura in 1930s St. Louis. When a gentleman caller visits, long-buried hopes and disappointments surface in this memory play about family, dreams, and escape.

title: Macbeth
synopsis: A Scottish general receives a prophecy from three witches that he will become king. Driven by ambition and his wife's manipulation, Macbeth murders King Duncan and descends into paranoia and tyranny, leading to his violent downfall.

title: A Doll's House
synopsis: Nora Helmer appears to live a perfect life until a secret from her past threatens to unravel everything. When her husband discovers the truth, his reaction forces Nora to recognize her own oppression and make a shocking decision about her future.

title: Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf?
synopsis: Middle-aged couple George and Martha invite a younger couple to their home after a faculty party. What begins as drinks and conversation escalates into a brutal night of psychological warfare, revealing painful truths and illusions about marriage.

title: The Importance of Being Earnest
synopsis: Two bachelors create fictitious personas to escape social obligations and court the women they love. Their elaborate deceptions spiral into hilarious complications, satirizing Victorian society's obsession with propriety and trivial matters.

title: Long Day's Journey Into Night
synopsis: The Tyrone family spends one day in their Connecticut home confronting addiction, illness, and decades of resentment. As day turns to night, buried secrets and accusations emerge in this semi-autobiographical portrait of a family's dysfunction.

title: Angels in America
synopsis: Set during the AIDS crisis in 1980s America, multiple storylines interweave following characters struggling with disease, sexuality, politics, and faith. This epic two-part play explores identity, love, and the possibility of redemption in desperate times.

title: The Cherry Orchard
synopsis: An aristocratic Russian family returns to their estate to face foreclosure and the auction of their beloved cherry orchard. Unable to adapt to changing times, they watch helplessly as their way of life disappears and a new social order emerges.

title: Fences
synopsis: Troy Maxson, a former baseball player turned garbage collector in 1950s Pittsburgh, struggles with bitterness over missed opportunities. His rigid attitudes and infidelity strain his relationships with his wife Rose and son Cory, leading to devastating consequences.

title: Cat on a Hot Tin Roof
synopsis: On Big Daddy's birthday, the Pollitt family gathers at the Mississippi plantation amid lies and tensions. Brick, an alcoholic ex-athlete, and his wife Maggie confront their troubled marriage while family members scheme over the dying patriarch's inheritance.

title: The Seagull
synopsis: At a Russian country estate, aspiring playwright Konstantin stages a play starring his love Nina, while his mother, a famous actress, dismisses his experimental work. Unrequited loves, artistic ambitions, and generational conflicts intertwine with tragic results.

title: Glengarry Glen Ross
synopsis: Desperate real estate salesmen in Chicago face cutthroat competition when the office announces a sales contest where only the top performers keep their jobs. Pressure mounts as the men resort to lies, theft, and betrayal to survive.

title: The Mousetrap
synopsis: Guests at a newly opened country guesthouse become snowbound during a blizzard just as news breaks of a murder in London. A police detective arrives to investigate, revealing that the killer may be among them in this classic mystery thriller.

title: Rhinoceros
synopsis: In a small French town, people begin mysteriously transforming into rhinoceroses. As the epidemic spreads, office worker Berenger watches friends and neighbors succumb to conformity, ultimately standing alone as the last human in an absurdist allegory about totalitarianism.
